items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: Slocum and a couple of other boys enlisted so we'd all stay together

ctx.x: the Queen's Throne Room was where the draft office was, in the Queen's Palace. So I was drafted in the Queen's Palace in Honolulu, and there was another boy drafted, and Slocum and a couple of other boys enlisted so we'd all stay together, and we all went in, and Wells was...they had discharged Wells, and he came back with us to Honolulu. He came to Honolulu and rejoined us. But he enlisted again, and we all went right into the Army together as the band in the Twenty-fifth Infantry, and we never went to France…
